title: The Undertow of Milton Flats
author: Sebastian Dravenmoor
blurb: Ansel Almeida, a piano tuner who hears the house's history in its radiators, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. Then a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must forgive the stranger in the old photographs, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
